plan.understanding: Replace the existing fillet at the front-side center (around the central bore) with a 1.0 mm chamfer.

subtasks.goal:
On SOLID #0 only (the coaxial hub: bbox x/z=±15.75, y=-4.625..3.175; vol≈2162.777), replace the existing front-side outer-corner fillet with a 1.0 mm × 1.0 mm 45° chamfer by doing a strictly local boolean CUT on SOLID #0 (do not run any delete-face/heal or any operation on the combined 2-solid shape).

Construction (no edge-chamfer feature, no face-delete heal):
1) Isolate SOLID #0 as the boolean target body. Keep SOLID #1 completely out of the boolean operation set.
2) Build a closed “chamfer removal” tool solid by revolving a 2D right-triangle profile about the hub axis (world Y through x=z=0). Define the profile in an axial section plane (e.g., X–Y plane) using SOLID #0’s known outer radius and front Y datum:
   - Use outer radius R_out = 15.75 (matches the only cylindrical face family r=15.75, axis ~[0,1,0], center ~[0,1.425,0]).
   - Use front plane Y_front = 3.175 (matches SOLID #0’s front planar face at y=3.175 with the smaller area ≈372.76, not the larger y=3.175 face).
   - Chamfer depth/width = 1.0 mm → Y_back = Y_front − 1.0 = 2.175, and R_front = R_out − 1.0 = 14.75.
   - Triangle vertices in (Y,R): A(2.175, 15.75), B(3.175, 15.75), C(3.175, 14.75). Revolve this triangular region 360° about the Y axis to create a watertight ring-wedge tool whose faces are: outer cylinder r=15.75, top plane y=3.175, bottom plane y=2.175, and inner conical surface giving the 45° chamfer.
3) Boolean CUT: SOLID #0 minus (revolved wedge tool). This single cut must remove the entire existing fillet region at the front outer rim (including any small-radius blend) and leave a clean conical chamfer face connecting the remaining outer cylinder (r=15.75) to the reduced front rim on the y=3.175 face (ending at r=14.75).
4) Recombine the final result as the original two-solid part: replace only SOLID #0 with the cut result; keep SOLID #1 as the exact original body (no re-sewing, no global shape-fix across both solids).
5) Verification checks:
   - SOLID #1: identical volume/area and no visible face edits anywhere on the spoked/main body.
   - SOLID #0: new conical chamfer face present at the front rim; no residual toroidal/fillet face remains at that corner; max extents unchanged (still x/z=±15.75, y_max=3.175).
